subject: [PATCH v4 09/14] SUNRPC: stop unregistering listeners once rpcbind stops answering

2026-08-31.patch_summary: This patch modifies the SUNRPC code to stop unregistering listeners once rpcbind stops answering. The original behavior caused multiple timeouts for each listener, which was unnecessary and inefficient. When rpcbind fails to respond, the patch clears a flag on remaining transport listeners, preventing further timeouts.
